question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Erase
solution:
The correct answer is, 'Create'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Erase means to delete or to make it disappear.
 
• For example, *the teacher erased all the old questions from the board to write new ones.*
 
• Create means to make or to invent.
 
• For example, *the Arts Teacher told his students to create something extraordinary.*
 
• Erase means to delete and Create means to make.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Strike** means **to attack** or to hit.
 
• **Delete** means **to erase**, making it a synonym for Erase.
 
• **Abolish** means to get rid of or **terminate**.
